title: Juvant OS instance security policy (security/policy.json)
description: decisions#305 / ADR 0034. Committed in the instance repo (never upstream-synced, never under .juvant/). Read by the PreToolUse hook from refs/remotes/origin/main. No secrets: webhook URLs and tokens stay in .juvant/config.json. The authoritative structural check is hooks/lib/security-policy.sh (juvant_policy_validate), run by scripts/validate-security-policy.sh.

connector_tool_allowlist.description: Deny-by-default allowlist for a vendor-hosted connector's tools (decisions#306).

required.description: Channels that must have a secret configured; an op that would raise a sensitive-space row is denied otherwise.
